info.text:
A two-provider practice is in Google's top three for primary care in Ellenton, Florida.

On Sept 24 we searched "Primary Care, Ellenton, FL" in a fresh incognito window and recorded the screen. Ellenton Family Practice Direct sits in the map's top three, next to practices many times their size. Above the regular results, Google's AI Overview names them first.

Nothing on the Google page is edited. Search results move, so run the search yourself.

Why it matters: the map and the AI Overview sit above every other result. For a local business, that top section is where a search is won or lost, and this result shows a small practice can hold its own there.

One thing to do this week: open an incognito window on your phone and search for your service plus your town, the way a new customer would. Note where you land, and whether your listing shows your hours, your reviews, and a working link to your site.

Local search is part of every site we build: pages that say clearly what you do and where you do it, clean structure that search engines can read, and a site that loads fast. Congratulations to the whole team at Ellenton Family Practice Direct.

The music is AI generated.
